result.summary: Found 3 issues: text truncation in the horizontal restaurant list, an inconsistent favorite icon styling, and a minor typo in the search placeholder.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated text 'Trattoria Piccol' being cut off at the right screen edge, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards align properly and consider adding partial card peek with proper spacing, or truncate with an ellipsis so the cutoff appears intentional.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons on the two 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background while the second has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background styling across all cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The search placeholder text reads 'Restarants' which is a spelling error for 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
